limits: The source itself visibly contains all 290 coordinates; excluding two of them is an error-model assumption, not a new visual transcription.
The ten words and their offsets were chosen after the old reading was known. Held-out spans test retrospective sensitivity, not a prospective blind prediction.
Every numerical/date/reference field is masked during the new geometry optimization. Geometry-dependent labels are retained literally and no calendar correction is imposed.

Search scope is the unchanged published key, exact retained source order, and zero/two/four source exclusions; no inference of global optimality over other keys, insertion models or arbitrary text is made.
Native corpus witnesses attest the specified ordinary words only, not message identity, recipient identity, opaque fields, dates or historical acts.
The four double-D descriptions are a transparent selected subfamily of twelve equal-cost word-only minima, not a unique historically demonstrated error location.
Every source coordinate is retained in the diplomatic source and appears either in the analysis map or the explicit exclusion ledger.
